description:
`notify` sends a message to you — no recipient or channel to specify, the platform already knows who's calling and where you want to hear from it.

Every call raises an in-app UnitySVC notification and sends you an email. If you've also set an external destination (`PUT /v1/users/me/notification-destination`), the same message is delivered there too — a webhook, chat app, or another email address, whatever you've configured. Nothing to set up on this end; just POST and it goes wherever you've already told UnitySVC to send it.

Can only send email rather than make an HTTP call? Use `smtp-notify` instead — same delivery, reached by sending a message over SMTP.
name: notify

payout_price.description: No platform commission — delivers to the caller's own configured destination

summary: POST a `msg` envelope and UnitySVC delivers it to you — in-app, by email, and through whatever external destination you've configured. No recipient or channel to specify.
